name: Yuzuki Miyuu
source: A girl who loves sea and stars. Currently she lives with her gentle grandparents. Because of congenital disease she can not study in the daytime so she go to the school on a fixed time basis. She likes animals such as dogs and cats very much, but because she can not have herself, she's taking care of a homeless animals.
